newsitem.title: USA: Farmstead Telephone extends warrant expiry.
newsitem.headline: Farmstead Telephone extends warrant expiry.

text.p: Farmstead Telephone Group Inc on Thursday that its board of directors extended the expiration date of the company's initial public offering warrants to June 30, 2002.
The warrants were previously scheduled to expire on June 30, 1997.
All other terms and conditions regarding the warrants are unaffected.
Presently, there are 183,579 warrants outstanding, each convertible into 1.06 shares of common stock at an exercise price of $4.70.
Shares of Farmstead, which distributes remanufactured telecommunications products, were unchanged at 2-1/2 Thursday afternoon.
